name: CORE API
rate_limits: Free tier: 1 batch request or 5 single requests per 10 seconds. API key required (free to register).
notes: World's largest collection of open access papers. 431M metadata records, 323M full-text links, 46M full texts hosted directly. Aggregates from thousands of data providers (institutional repositories, publishers). Key differentiator: provides actual full-text content, not just metadata. API v3 is current. Free API key available at core.ac.uk. Rust and R client libraries available. Lower rate limits than other academic APIs on free tier.
